input.sql:
SELECT c.name, c.artist, c.isPromo, COUNT(r.uuid) AS ruling_count
FROM rulings r
JOIN cards c ON c.uuid = r.uuid
GROUP BY r.uuid
ORDER BY ruling_count DESC
LIMIT 10

input.sql:
SELECT c.name, c.artist, c.isPromo
FROM cards c
JOIN rulings r ON r.uuid = c.uuid
GROUP BY c.uuid
HAVING COUNT(r.uuid) = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(uuid) AS cnt FROM rulings GROUP BY uuid))
   AND c.isPromo = 1
